{{Quote|The first transport is away! The first transport is away!|[[Romas Navander/Legends|Romas "Lock" Navander]], during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>|audio=Navander-Transport.flac}}
The '''''Quantum Storm''''', also known as '''Echo C-130''', was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] in service to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].

==History==
[[File:QuantumStorm.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Quantum Storm'' escaping the ''Tyrant'', disabled by the planetary ion cannon]]
The ''Quantum Storm'' was the first [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to escape the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. It successfully bypassed the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], thanks to the well-timed shots of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base's]] [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[Planetary ion cannon|ion cannon]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

As the first transport to evacuate the planet, the ''Quantum Storm'' carried non-combatant members of Echo Base. Alliance historian [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] was supposed to be one such passenger, but he instead stayed behind to help with the evacuation effort of subsequent transports.<ref name="GG3" />
